gameDescriptionHtml:
System Breakdown is not just a twin-stick shooter. You need to be aggressive in order to survive. Cycle between guns to gain ammunition. Perform the finisher move to heal yourself. Use special power-ups to destroy Clankers’ armor and charge your Fury.

If you like games, such as Ruiner or Kill Knight, you will feel at home.

Big Brother monitors everything. The better you perform in trials, the more resources you earn for advanced weaponry and power-ups.

Build your own style of destruction. Do you want to focus on pushing enemies onto a rocket explosion, or a Kimbo assault rifle Rambo Style? The choice is yours.

The Soviets won the Cold War, later created Big Brother to oversee this communist utopia. Everyone is equal, everyone is the same, everyone owns nothing, nobody can say anything.

You are the last remnant of human hope. Locked in the Big Brother laboratory, you need to find a way to destroy his reign once and for all.
